notes: INSIDE half of the Emberkin Flare Turret: a magazine rack where flare cartridges (brass casings, coloured caps) slide into the chamber one by one as it charges (frame 5 = five loaded, strip yellow), power coupling, brass hatch. fire: the chamber flashes and the rack is empty. damaged: a cartridge jammed crooked, the rack cracked, lamps dead; disabled: cartridges spilled, rack bent. Barrel layer emberkin_flare_turret_barrel: a brass dome head with a short flare gun, a flared muzzle and a small heat-sink fin stack.
